[[File:Graf-zapalo.jpg|thumb|200px|right|Master of Sciences [[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]]]]
'''Master of Sciences''' was the title held by the member of the [[Naboo Royal Advisory Council/Legends|Naboo Royal Advisory Council]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|368|Zapalo, Graf}}</ref> in charge of supervision of [[Scientist/Legends|scientific]] research on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Mantaris">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010215b&c=rpg|text=The ''Mantaris''}}</ref> The associated bureaucracy was known as the '''Office of the Master of Science of Naboo'''.<ref name="SWG:TTUR">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Thugs Threaten University Researchers}} on Naboo</ref>

==History==
[[Graf Zapalo/Legends|Graf Zapalo]] was the Master of Sciences during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Following the conclusion of the Invasion of Naboo by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] and [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]] initiated a series of scientific projects to bring the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] peoples closer together. These projects resulted in Gungan and Naboo scientists and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] working together under the supervision of Master of Sciences Zapalo. The most ambitious project was the development of the [[Mantaris-class amphibious medium transport|''Mantaris''-class amphibious medium transport]] and the subsequent [[Colonization of Ohma-D'un/Legends|colonization]] of Naboo's [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]].<ref name="Mantaris" /> Another project oversaw by the Master of Sciences was the exploration and complete mapping of the tunnels of the [[Naboo Abyss/Legends|Naboo Abyss]].<ref name="ER1">{{Wizards|url=starwars/article.asp?x=sw20010222a&c=rpg|text=The ER-1 Probe Droid: More Secrets of Naboo}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of researchers from the [[Theed University/Legends|Theed University]] investigating interference with [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Motivator/Legends|motivators]] were harassed by a band of Nabooian criminals. After the thugs threatened the scientists to death and tried to destroy their laboratory, the Office of the Master of Science contacted [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] authorities. However, since the Empire remained inactive, spacers were eventually hired to deal with the criminals.<ref name="SWG:TTUR" />
